# Smoke fixtures

These files are small, fixed inputs for the browser smoke test. They are not a benchmark set and are not used to tune the detector.

- `ai-generated.png` is an in-house generated image with an embedded C2PA marker.
- `real-photograph.jpg` is a landscape photograph downloaded from [Unsplash](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1501785888041-af3ef285b470).

The third smoke case, `synthetic`, is created as a deterministic canvas image by `smoke-page.html`.
